declared_before: building the AnnData or running any decoupler MCP tool on GSE153970 (only the GEO sample sheet, the count-matrix header and the PubMed abstract had been read)
design: ~condition, contrast SARS-CoV-2 vs mock (3 vs 3, unpaired), primary human airway epithelial cultures, MOI 0.25, 48 h

sources.Vanderheiden et al. 2020 J Virol, doi:10: infected cultures had a signature dominated by IL-6, TNF-a and CXCL8 induction; NF-kB and ATF-4 identified as key drivers; 'a complete lack of a type I or III interferon (IFN) response'

superseded_hypothesis.text: NDE exemplar table (2026-10-28): 'Interferon (STAT/IRF) and inflammatory signalling'
superseded_hypothesis.why: the abstract of the generating study reports the opposite for interferon: no type I or III IFN response. The inflammatory half is kept (E1-E3); the interferon half is replaced by the expected absence (E4). The original hypothesis is reported, not scored.

expectations.claim: CollecTRI ulm: NFKB1 and RELA each have score > 0 and padj < 0.05
CollecTRI ulm: ATF4 has score > 0 and padj < 0.05
IL6, TNF and CXCL8 each have log2FoldChange > 0 and padj < 0.05

No interferon response: Hallmark INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE, CollecTRI STAT2 and CollecTRI IRF9 are each NOT (score > 0 and padj < 0.05); IFNB1 and IFNL1 are each NOT (log2FoldChange > 0 and padj < 0.05), counting a gene removed by expression filtering as not induced
expectations.source: Vanderheiden 2020 abstract (complete lack of type I/III IFN response)

expectations.claim: Report only: genes kept; PCA; DE gene count at padj<0.05; top 10 TFs, PROGENy pathways and Hallmark sets; outcome of the superseded NDE interferon hypothesis
